info.name: Site 14 API tests
info.description: End-to-end run: sign in, build test data, track a watch, read it back, check errors, clean up. Run the folders in order (0 to 6). Needs baseUrl and a company admin refresh_token (or a fresh access_token). Use a local or test server, not production.

exec: // A tag for this run, so its names and serial numbers are new every time.
// Today in Riyadh (UTC+3), the day the API files readings under.
// With a refresh token this gets a fresh access token; without one, the access_token you pasted is used.
pm.test("Refresh answered (200, or 401/422 when only an access_token is set)", () => pm.expect([200, 401, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test("Signed in: set refresh_token or a fresh access_token if this fails", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Role is company_admin (the run creates sites, which only an admin can)", () => pm.expect(b.role).to.eql("company_admin"));

item.name: The site is in the list
Create a zone inside the site
A zone outside the site is refused
Create an employee on the site

exec: pm.test("On the test site, consent recorded", () => { pm.expect(b.site_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get("t_site_id")); pm.expect(b.consent_given_at).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Comes with its key, once", () => pm.expect(b.api_key).to.be.a("string"));

item.name: Give the watch to the employee
A wrong device key is refused
The watch sends a reading inside the zone
The worker is on the live map

exec: pm.test("Listed with a position", () => { pm.expect(me).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(me.has_position).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Today's record shows the worker present
An empty site gives 422 with the fields
A site with workers cannot be deactivated
Deactivate the watch (it has a shift, so it is kept)
